# Volante Tower III

> Volante III is a high-end residential tower planned for Business Bay, the canal-side district immediately south of Downtown Dubai. It extends the Volante series of low-density luxury towers beside the Dubai Water Canal, whose first building gives each residence a half or full floor with skyline and waterway views. The area is served by Business Bay metro station and sits minutes from Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Business Bay, Dubai, UAE

## MENASCO Scope

Volante III Tower is a high-end residential tower in Business Bay, Dubai, continuing Xtreme Vision's Volante series of ultra-luxury residences. MENASCO is responsible for the MEP works on the tower, building on its earlier delivery of the complete MEP scope for Volante II Tower and bringing the same focus on engineering quality and precise installation to the next phase of the series.
